escena: SCENE (paper and finish selection seen from directly above, bindery in Lima, morning, NO faces): the camera looks STRAIGHT DOWN from about two metres onto a dark walnut worktop, perfectly perpendicular, so the surface is a flat graphic plane; on it, printed samples, swatch fans and a loupe are arranged in the middle of being worked — not tidily aligned, but caught mid-process. FOUR HANDS enter from different edges of the frame: one pulling a sample halfway out, one holding a corner down, one reaching in. A hard shaft of window light cuts a diagonal band of light across the worktop at the moment the sample is lifted. No faces, no heads, no bodies — only hands and forearms from the frame edges. 35mm from directly overhead, focus on the worktop plane. Everything is completely unbranded, no readable text anywhere.
